instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: Okay, so backwards L. So blue at the blue block pointing this way at the top and then two red blocks stacked on one on top of the other on the right hand side. So we get a little backwards L.

assumptions: The blue block is placed on the ground (y=0). The phrase "at the top" is interpreted as referring to the back row (z=0) or a general placement on the grid, not an elevated position.
"Pointing this way" for the blue block (default axis=x) means it is oriented along the x-axis.
The "backwards L" implies the red stack is on the right end of the blue block.
The red blocks are centered on the right end of the blue block's top surface.
evidence: So blue at the blue block pointing this way at the top
and then two red blocks stacked on one on top of the other on the right hand side.
